providers.name: Ollama Cloud
providers.notes: Scope: direct cloud access at https://ollama.com, covering the OpenAI-compatible /v1 API RubyLLM uses, the native /api and Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages routes it does not use, System One, and the hosted search and fetch APIs. Local server features count only where the docs or cloud catalogs place them on the hosted API.

chat.notes: Cloud models through the Ollama dialect of Chat Completions at https://ollama.com/v1.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat basic chat functionality ollama_cloud/gpt-oss:120b can have a basic conversation
verification.notes: Recorded against ollama.com/v1/chat/completions.

streaming.notes: Server-sent Chat Completions chunks on cloud models, with usage in the final chunk.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat streaming responses ollama_cloud/gpt-oss:120b supports streaming responses
verification.notes: Recorded against ollama.com/v1/chat/completions.

structured_output.notes: The official guide says Ollama Cloud does not support structured outputs. RubyLLM removes the capability from Cloud models.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Providers::OllamaCloud model listing reports no structured output, which Ollama Cloud does not support
verification.notes: Checks the capability list a Cloud model gets.

vision.notes: Cloud models that report vision in the catalog. The endpoint takes base64 images and rejects image URLs; RubyLLM always sends a data URI.

pdf_input.notes: Chat Completions documents text and image parts only, and the Anthropic-compatible route lists PDF document blocks as unsupported. RubyLLM raises UnsupportedAttachmentError for a PDF.

audio_input.notes: RubyLLM sends input_audio parts through the Ollama dialect, but the chat references document text and image parts only, and no model in the cloud catalogs reports audio input. Whether a Cloud chat request accepts audio is unverified.

video_input.notes: The chat references document text and image parts only. RubyLLM raises UnsupportedAttachmentError for video.

thinking.notes: Cloud models that report thinking return reasoning text, which RubyLLM reads into thinking.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat function calling ollama_cloud/gpt-oss:120b can use tools
verification.notes: The recorded gpt-oss:120b response carries a reasoning field. The spec does not assert the thinking text.

thinking_controls.notes: with_thinking(effort:) sends reasoning_effort; each model defines its values, and unsupported names resolve to the model default. Ollama has no thinking budget, so RubyLLM raises when given one.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Providers::Ollama::Chat .render_payload raises for a thinking budget
verification.notes: Covers the Ollama dialect that OllamaCloud::ChatCompletions inherits.

citations.notes: No citations operation is documented. The Anthropic-compatible route lists citation blocks as unsupported.

tools.notes: Function tools on cloud models that report tools in the catalog.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat function calling ollama_cloud/gpt-oss:120b can use tools
verification.notes: Recorded against ollama.com/v1/chat/completions, through the tool result round.

tool_choice.notes: The compatibility checklists mark tool_choice unsupported on both /v1/chat/completions and /v1/messages. RubyLLM sends tool_choice when you set it, and the endpoint decides what to do with it.

parallel_tools.notes: Ollama documents parallel tool calls, and RubyLLM reads every call in a response. The gpt-oss:120b recordings returned one call per turn, so several calls in one response have no Cloud recording.

parallel_tool_control.notes: The compatibility checklist lists no parallel_tool_calls field, and neither the chat reference nor the Anthropic-compatible route documents a limit on parallel calls.

server_web_search.notes: Ollama search is a REST API that you call yourself or wrap as a function tool. The cloud API excludes built-in web search through /v1/responses, and the Anthropic-compatible route says hosted web search is not fully supported.

server_web_fetch.notes: Ollama web fetch is a REST API that you call yourself or wrap as a function tool. No hosted fetch tool is documented.

server_code_execution.notes: No dedicated code execution tool operation is documented in the Ollama Cloud API.

server_file_search.notes: No dedicated file search tool operation is documented in the Ollama Cloud API.

server_mcp.notes: No dedicated remote MCP tools operation is documented in the Ollama Cloud API.

prompt_caching.notes: Automatic, with no RubyLLM switch. Cloud chat responses report prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, which RubyLLM reads into cache_read. The cloud usage API counts cached input tokens and pricing lists a cached input rate for most models. The docs do not describe the cache rules.

websockets.notes: No dedicated Responses over WebSocket operation is documented in the Ollama Cloud API.

gaps.notes: Responses API: Cloud documents stateless /v1/responses requests; OllamaCloud registers only Chat Completions.
Standalone search API, Standalone web fetch API: The hosted search and fetch REST APIs have no RubyLLM operation.

Text embeddings, Speech generation, Streaming speech generation, Transcription, Streaming transcription, Dedicated transcription API, Audio input: The references document these without limiting them to local servers, and RubyLLM would send them through Chat Completions, but the cloud catalogs list no model for them. Availability on ollama.com is unverified.

Fill-in-the-middle completion, Prefix completion: The completions routes document suffix and raw prompts, but no page establishes either behavior on a cloud model. RubyLLM has no completions operation.

providers.name: GPUStack
providers.notes: Scope: GPUStack 2.3 standard inference routes and its documented built-in backends, including vLLM and vLLM-Omni. Support depends on the deployed model, backend version and settings, and vLLM or vLLM-Omni routes outside the gateway need Generic Proxy enabled on the deployment. GPU administration and external model-provider integrations are outside the comparison.

chat.notes: Chat Completions at /v1/chat/completions on deployed text models. Backend and model decide what each deployment accepts.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat basic chat functionality gpustack/qwen3 can have a basic conversation
verification.notes: Successful chat response.

streaming.notes: stream: true on Chat Completions with SSE deltas and final usage.

verification.notes: Streamed deltas from the gateway route.

structured_output.notes: with_schema sends response_format json_schema, which vLLM documents. GPUStack does not document it separately, and no GPUStack recording covers it. Other backends may differ.

vision.notes: Images are sent inline as image_url parts on vision models. Local and remote images both become data URLs, because clusters often cannot reach the internet.

verification.notes: sends remote images inline, because clusters often cannot reach the internet

pdf_input.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document PDF input.

audio_input.notes: input_audio content parts on audio-capable vLLM models. The deployed model must support audio.

video_input.notes: video_url content parts, with remote and local videos sent as data URLs. Requires a video-capable vLLM or vLLM-Omni deployment; other backends and models may not accept video.

verification.notes: accepts video attachments through the public chat API; sends remote videos inline; encodes local video attachments as data URLs

thinking.notes: Reads reasoning_content or reasoning from responses and streams, and replays it on later turns. vLLM needs a reasoning parser on the deployment; GPUStack does not document this field separately.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat with extended thinking gpustack/qwen3 streams thinking content when available

Model-specific switches such as chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking go through provider options. Effect depends on the model and backend, and no GPUStack recording sends an effort.

citations.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Citations.

tools.notes: Function tools on Chat Completions. Deployments need tool calling enabled (for vLLM, --enable-auto-tool-choice and a tool call parser). vLLM and SGLang document it.

verification.notes: Tool call and follow-up turn.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat tool choice and calls control gpustack/qwen3 respects choice: :none
verification.notes: Request sends tool_choice none; the recording covers this value only.

parallel_tools.notes: Reads several tool calls from one response. vLLM says the count depends on the model.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat function calling gpustack/qwen3 can use parallel tool calls
verification.notes: Response holds several tool calls.

parallel_tool_control.notes: with_tool_options(calls:) sends parallel_tool_calls. vLLM documents false as returning at most one call. No GPUStack recording sends the field.

server_web_search.notes: with_provider_tools(web_search: { require_approval: "never" }) selects the search subtool of the configured web_search_preview server. Requires protocol: :responses and a tool server configured on the vLLM deployment with --tool-server. RubyLLM requires an explicit require_approval: "never" because vLLM has no approval events, and it rejects per-request URLs, connectors and authorization because vLLM connects only to its configured servers. The allowed_tools filter limits the tool descriptions shown to the model, so restrict execution on the tool server itself. RubyLLM keeps call records as the backend returns them and never invents a result.

Requires protocol: :responses and a tool server configured on the vLLM deployment with --tool-server. RubyLLM requires an explicit require_approval: "never" because vLLM has no approval events, and it rejects per-request URLs, connectors and authorization because vLLM connects only to its configured servers. The allowed_tools filter limits the tool descriptions shown to the model, so restrict execution on the tool server itself. RubyLLM keeps call records as the backend returns them and never invents a result.

verification.notes: sends configured MCP labels and preserves complete calls, usage, and multi-turn replay; rejects approval modes, per-request servers, and ignored read-only filters before HTTP

prompt_caching.notes: Built-in backends reuse prefixes automatically, and shared cache services extend that for vLLM and SGLang. RubyLLM reads prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens into cache_read. Deployment settings decide whether caching runs and is reported.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat streaming responses gpustack/qwen3 reports token usage with and without streaming
verification.notes: Usage includes cached_tokens.

cache_boundaries.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Cache boundaries.

explicit_cache.notes: Cache services are shared KV infrastructure that administrators attach to deployments. GPUStack documents no per-request cache resource that clients create.

compaction.notes: vLLM documents truncate_prompt_tokens with truncation_side on Chat Completions, and truncation_side: "left" keeps the last N tokens. provider_options forwards both. RubyLLM with_compaction has no GPUStack integration, and this is plain truncation rather than summarization.

token_counting.notes: RubyLLM.tokenize returns exact IDs and a count for plain text through vLLM /tokenize, using a gpustack_api_base ending in /model/proxy/ROUTE_ID/v1. The gateway base is rejected before any request. vLLM /tokenize also accepts messages, but Chat#count_tokens and RubyLLM.count_tokens have no GPUStack implementation, so conversations, tools and media cannot be counted. Pure diffusion servers do not expose /tokenize.

verification.notes: uses the model proxy tokenizer and preserves IDs and raw backend metadata without charging usage; rejects gateway tokenization before issuing a request

image_generation.notes: paint uses /v1/images/generations on image deployments. Backend and model support are required.

image_editing.notes: paint(with:) uses multipart /v1/images/edits on image deployments. Backend and model support are required.

video_generation.notes: animate and animate_later use vLLM-Omni /v1/videos with non-idempotent multipart submission, polling, and MP4 download from /content. Requires gpustack_api_base to end in /model/proxy/ROUTE_ID/v1, with Generic Proxy enabled on the deployment; RubyLLM rejects the standard gateway base before any request. GPUStack 2.3 also routes video requests through its gateway, which RubyLLM does not use. One result per call; uploaded file IDs and extension raise before any request. vLLM-Omni also documents video listing and deletion, which RubyLLM does not expose.

verification.notes: submits text-only multipart once, polls all states, and downloads bytes with proxy authentication; rejects unsupported gateway routes, references, multi-output requests, and extension before HTTP

speech.notes: speak uses /v1/audio/speech on vLLM and VoxBox deployments. Pass voice: and format: explicitly: without them RubyLLM sends the voice alloy, which deployed models may not offer, and labels the result mp3 although vLLM-Omni defaults to wav.

transcription.notes: transcribe uses multipart /v1/audio/transcriptions on vLLM and VoxBox deployments. Supported models and optional fields depend on the backend.

streaming_transcription.notes: transcribe with a block reads vLLM choices[].delta.content, assembles the transcript, and keeps final token usage. Requires the vLLM backend; VoxBox does not stream.

verification.notes: streams vLLM text and retains a separate final usage event; marks the stream done once, with the whole transcript

diarization.notes: format: "diarized_json" returns speaker-labelled segments, and RubyLLM requests it by default for model ids containing diarize. vLLM documents this for MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize only. VoxBox and named speaker references are not documented.

moderation.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Moderation.

ocr.notes: GPUStack's inference routes and vLLM-Omni's endpoint list have no OCR or document parsing route. Reading an image through chat is counted under image input.

embeddings.notes: embed uses /v1/embeddings on embedding deployments. Several texts go in one request.

verification.notes: preserves text batches and provider options

multimodal_embeddings.notes: embed(..., with: image) sends vLLM messages and returns one vector. Requires a multimodal embedding model with a chat template on vLLM; several texts cannot be combined with attachments.

verification.notes: embeds text and an image through the messages request format; accepts image attachments through the public API and returns one vector

reranking.notes: rerank uses the Jina-compatible /v1/rerank route on reranker deployments.

file_upload.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document File upload.

file_download.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document File download.

chat_batches.notes: vLLM documents /v1/chat/completions/batch, which runs several conversations in one request, reachable through an enabled Generic Proxy. GPUStack does not list it among its gateway routes. RubyLLM has no batch integration for this provider, and provider options cannot change the route.

embedding_batches.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Embedding batches.

advisor_tool.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Advisor tool.

agent_responses.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Perplexity Agent API.

agent_skills.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Agent skills.

async_research.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Asynchronous research.

background_responses.notes: vLLM Responses documents retrieval and cancel routes and accepts background when VLLM_ENABLE_RESPONSES_API_STORE=1 is set on the deployment. GPUStack lists only Create Response, so those routes need Generic Proxy. provider_options can send background and store, but RubyLLM has no retrieval, polling or cancel lifecycle, and normal requests send store: false.

browser_use.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Browser use.

classification.notes: vLLM documents /classify for classification models, reachable through an enabled Generic Proxy. RubyLLM has no classification request or typed result.

computer_use.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Computer use.

context_editing.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Context editing.

contextual_embeddings.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Contextual embeddings.

dedicated_transcription_api.notes: transcribe uses the dedicated multipart /v1/audio/transcriptions route. Supported models and optional fields depend on the backend.

dubbing.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Dubbing.

fast_inference.notes: No fast tier is documented. vLLM's priority field only orders requests in a deployment configured for priority scheduling.

file_management.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document File listing and deletion.

file_search_store_management.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document File search store management.

fill_in_middle.notes: vLLM documents the suffix parameter of /v1/completions as unsupported, and GPUStack and SGLang document no fill-in-the-middle parameter.

fine_tuning.notes: GPUStack serves LoRA adapters on deployments but documents no training API.

google_maps.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Google Maps grounding.

guardrail_configuration.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Guardrail configuration.

hosted_conversations.notes: vLLM Responses can continue through previous_response_id when VLLM_ENABLE_RESPONSES_API_STORE=1 is set on the deployment. This is provider-stored state and stays outside RubyLLM 2.0; conversation history stays in the application.

image_batches.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Image batches.

interactions_api.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Interactions API.

json_mode.notes: vLLM accepts response_format json_object, and provider_options forwards it. RubyLLM exposes schema output separately.

mantle_protocols.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Bedrock Mantle protocols.

manual_compaction.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Manual context compaction.

music_generation.notes: vLLM-Omni documents /v1/audio/generate for music on diffusion audio models such as Stable Audio, reachable through an enabled Generic Proxy. RubyLLM has no audio generation operation.

nonchat_batches.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Other batch operations.

omni_video_generation.notes: animate and animate_later map ordered image, audio and video references to vLLM-Omni multipart fields and return typed VideoJob and Video results. Valid combinations depend on the model; vLLM-Omni says not to combine image_reference with video_reference. Requires gpustack_api_base to end in /model/proxy/ROUTE_ID/v1, with Generic Proxy enabled on the deployment; RubyLLM rejects the standard gateway base before any request.

verification.notes: serializes image and audio input and nested backend options as JSON multipart fields; preserves ordered multiple references and sends remote references inline

partner_model_protocols.notes: GPUStack documents an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages route on deployed models, and native forwarding for Anthropic providers through protocol: original. RubyLLM declares only Chat Completions and Responses for this provider, so its Anthropic protocol cannot be selected.

prefix_completion.notes: vLLM documents continue_final_message on Chat Completions to continue a final assistant message, used with add_generation_prompt: false. provider_options forwards both after you add the assistant message. GPUStack does not document it separately.

programmatic_tool_calling.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Programmatic tool calling.

prompt_cache_controls.notes: vLLM documents cache_salt to isolate prefix cache reuse, and provider_options forwards it. with_caching(key:) sends prompt_cache_key, which a route with session affinity can use as its body key. GPUStack documents no TTL or retention option.

provider_server_fallback.notes: Administrators set a fallback target on a model route, and requests through RubyLLM use it with no client option. RubyLLM does not configure routes or report which target served a request.

realtime.notes: vLLM documents a /v1/realtime WebSocket for streaming transcription, and vLLM-Omni documents realtime audio over the same path. GPUStack's gateway and Generic Proxy pages do not say whether WebSockets are forwarded to a deployment. If they are, this stays outside RubyLLM 2.0.

response_caching.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Response caching.

responses.notes: protocol: :responses uses /v1/responses on the gateway or model proxy, and normal chat stays on Chat Completions. Usage and MCP items use the shared Responses parser, with vLLM replay normalization. GPUStack also offers per-endpoint protocol selection. Backend and model support are required.

verification.notes: requires explicit execution consent and keeps ordinary chat on Chat Completions; reads actual Harmony reasoning content when the provider has no summary

responses_batches.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Responses batches.

search_api.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Standalone search API.

server_apply_patch.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Apply patch tool.

server_tool_image_generation.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Image generation tool.

server_tool_search.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Tool search.

server_x_search.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document X search tool.

shell_computer_tools.notes: vLLM's Harmony and tool dispatch code has a container tool that expects a stateful Docker server, and its MCP example lists a container label for gpt-oss. No page documents the tool contract. RubyLLM's mcp alias accepts the container label, but no spec or recording covers it, so availability stays unverified.

sound_effects.notes: vLLM-Omni documents /v1/audio/generate for sound effects and ambient audio on diffusion audio models, reachable through an enabled Generic Proxy. RubyLLM has no audio generation operation.

streaming_speech.notes: speak with a block sends stream: true, defaults to PCM, and returns typed audio chunks. Requires the vLLM backend; VoxBox does not stream. vLLM-Omni's separate WebSocket text streaming is not used.

verification.notes: requests the vLLM binary stream with PCM as its default format

task_budgets.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Task budgets.

text_intelligence.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Text analysis API.

vector_store_management.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Vector store management.

video_batches.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Video batches.

video_editing.notes: animate(with: source_video) sends vLLM-Omni video_reference through the model proxy, for models that support video-to-video. Remote references are sent inline. Uses the same lifecycle as generation. Requires gpustack_api_base to end in /model/proxy/ROUTE_ID/v1, with Generic Proxy enabled on the deployment; RubyLLM rejects the standard gateway base before any request.

verification.notes: accepts a local video through the public attachment API and sends a JSON reference field

video_extension.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Video extension.

voice_cloning.notes: GPUStack documents Qwen3-TTS reference audio voice cloning, and vLLM-Omni documents ref_audio and ref_text on /v1/audio/speech. speak forwards them through provider_options. vLLM-Omni also has /v1/audio/voices for uploading voices, which RubyLLM does not expose.

voice_conversion.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Voice conversion.

web_fetch_api.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Standalone web fetch API.

websockets.notes: GPUStack's standard inference routes and documented built-in backends do not document Responses over WebSocket.

gaps.notes: Web search tool, Web fetch tool, Code execution tool, Remote MCP tools: these need protocol: :responses and a tool server configured on vLLM. Per-request MCP URLs and approvals do not exist upstream, and allowed_tools does not restrict execution. Fetch needs a Harmony model.
Token counting: plain text goes through RubyLLM.tokenize on the model proxy. vLLM /tokenize also accepts messages, but Chat#count_tokens has no GPUStack implementation.
Background Responses jobs: background needs a store enabled on the vLLM deployment, and RubyLLM has no retrieval, polling or cancel lifecycle.
Chat batches: vLLM /v1/chat/completions/batch has no RubyLLM integration and is reached only through Generic Proxy.
Classification: vLLM /classify has no RubyLLM operation.
Music generation, Sound effects: vLLM-Omni /v1/audio/generate has no RubyLLM operation.
Partner model protocols: GPUStack's Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages route cannot be selected, because RubyLLM declares only Chat Completions and Responses here.
Provider-managed fallback: route fallback targets are set by administrators. Requests use them transparently, but RubyLLM cannot configure them or report which target answered.

Video generation, Omni video generation, Video editing: RubyLLM reaches vLLM-Omni only through the model proxy, not the /v1/videos gateway routing added in GPUStack 2.3, and does not expose listing or deletion.
Speech generation: pass voice: and format: explicitly, because the defaults are alloy and mp3 while vLLM-Omni defaults to wav.
Voice cloning: ref_audio and ref_text go through provider_options, and /v1/audio/voices uploads have no RubyLLM API.

JSON object mode, Prefix completion, Prompt cache options, Context compaction: these use vLLM fields through provider_options (response_format, continue_final_message, cache_salt, truncate_prompt_tokens).
Realtime sessions, Shell and computer tools: GPUStack WebSocket forwarding and vLLM's container tool contract are not documented.

providers.name: Hetzner
providers.notes: Scope: Hetzner's OpenAI-compatible Inference API serving Qwen open-weight models, not its separate OpenClaw experiment. Its one documentation page, last changed 2026-07-24, describes an experimental service at /api/v1 with no parameter reference, so streaming, tools and thinking rest on API recordings made at /v1 on 2026-11-04 with Qwen3.8-27B.

chat.notes: Documented /v1/chat/completions, reached through a Hetzner dialect of Chat Completions. Instructions use the system role.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat basic chat functionality hetzner/Qwen3.8-27B can have a basic conversation
verification.notes: Recorded against https://inference.hetzner.com/v1/chat/completions; asserts the answer, role and token usage.

streaming.notes: The Inference API page does not mention streaming. Recorded responses show the /v1/chat/completions stream works, with usage in the final chunk through stream_options.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat streaming responses hetzner/Qwen3.8-27B supports streaming responses
verification.notes: Recorded streamed response; asserts chunks arrive and the final response carries status 200.

structured_output.notes: The Inference API page has no request parameter reference and does not mention response_format. RubyLLM sends json_schema response_format through with_schema, and the model registry marks Qwen3.8-27B as supporting structured output, but no recording shows the API honoring it.

vision.notes: The page documents text and image input for its Qwen models. RubyLLM sends every image, including remote ones, as an inline data URL, although the page shows image URLs.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat vision models hetzner/Qwen3.8-27B can understand local images
verification.notes: Request carries a data:image/png URL; asserts the reply describes the image.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat vision models hetzner/Qwen3.8-27B can understand remote images without extension
verification.notes: RubyLLM downloads the image, then sends it inline.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Providers::Hetzner attachments sends remote images inline, because Hetzner cannot fetch URLs
verification.notes: Checks the data URL rendered for a remote image.

pdf_input.notes: The page lists text and image modalities only. RubyLLM raises UnsupportedAttachmentError for documents before sending.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Providers::Hetzner attachments rejects documents and audio, which the models do not accept
verification.notes: Checks that a PDF raises UnsupportedAttachmentError.

audio_input.notes: The page lists text and image modalities only. RubyLLM raises UnsupportedAttachmentError for audio before sending.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Providers::Hetzner attachments rejects documents and audio, which the models do not accept
verification.notes: Checks that a WAV file raises UnsupportedAttachmentError.

video_input.notes: The page lists text and image modalities only. RubyLLM rejects video attachments before sending.

thinking.notes: The page does not document thinking output. Recorded Qwen3.8-27B responses from 2026-11-04 return message.reasoning, delta.reasoning and reasoning_tokens, and RubyLLM parses all three. No spec asserts the thinking text for this provider.

thinking_controls.notes: The Inference API page has no request parameter reference and does not mention reasoning_effort. with_thinking(effort:) sends reasoning_effort, but no recording shows the API honoring it. A bare call sends nothing, because the registry lists no reasoning options for Qwen3.8-27B.

citations.notes: Hetzner's Inference API page lists /v1/models, /v1/completions and /v1/chat/completions as its only endpoints and does not document citations. Recorded responses return annotations as null.

tools.notes: The page does not document tool calling. Recorded Qwen3.8-27B responses show function tools work on /v1/chat/completions, including tool results, streaming and nested parameters.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat function calling hetzner/Qwen3.8-27B can use tools
verification.notes: Recorded tool call and follow-up; asserts the reply uses the tool result.

tool_choice.notes: The Inference API page has no request parameter reference and does not mention tool_choice. RubyLLM sends it through with_tool_options(choice:), but no recording covers it: the shared spec skips Qwen3.8-27B because the registry has no tool_choice capability.

parallel_tools.notes: The page does not document this. Recorded Qwen3.8-27B responses return two calls to different tools and three calls to one tool in a single response.

verification.example: RubyLLM::Chat function calling hetzner/Qwen3.8-27B can use parallel tool calls
verification.notes: First response carries weather and best_language_to_learn calls.

parallel_tool_control.notes: The Inference API page has no request parameter reference and does not mention parallel_tool_calls. RubyLLM sends it through with_tool_options(calls:), but no recording shows the API honoring it.

server_web_fetch.notes: Hetzner's Inference API page lists /v1/models, /v1/completions and /v1/chat/completions as its only endpoints and does not document a hosted web fetch tool. The Chat Completions protocol registers no server tool aliases.

server_code_execution.notes: Hetzner's Inference API page lists /v1/models, /v1/completions and /v1/chat/completions as its only endpoints and does not document a hosted code execution tool. The Chat Completions protocol registers no server tool aliases.

server_file_search.notes: Hetzner's Inference API page lists /v1/models, /v1/completions and /v1/chat/completions as its only endpoints and does not document a hosted file search tool. The Chat Completions protocol registers no server tool aliases.
